import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_3.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN : [["Source3_68_0", "Source3_68_1"], ["Wrestler", "Wrestler"]]
# Join df0 and df1 on 'Wrestler' with suffixes to distinguish columns
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Wrestler", suffixes=('_2013', '_2014'))

# Operation 2: UNION : ['Source3_68_2', 'Source3_68_3']
# Union df2 and df3 (same schema)
df_union = pd.concat([df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# Operation 3: group_by and aggregations
# Group by df_joined['Wrestler'] and aggregate sums of all relevant columns from df_joined and df_union

# For aggregation, we need to sum:
# From df_joined (df0 and df1):
#   df0: Wins, Losses, Draws  -> renamed to Wins_2013, Losses_2013, Draws_2013
#   df1: Wins, Losses, Draws  -> renamed to Wins_2014, Losses_2014, Draws_2014
# From df_union (df2 and df3):
#   We have two years: 2015 and 2016, but df_union combines both years.
#   We need to separate 2015 and 2016 data by source table origin:
#   - df2 corresponds to 2015
#   - df3 corresponds to 2016
# So we must keep track of which rows come from which year before union.

# To do this, add a 'Year' column before union:
df2['Year'] = 2015
df3['Year'] = 2016
df_union = pd.concat([df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# Now group df_union by Wrestler and Year, summing Wins, Losses, Draws
df_union_grouped = df_union.groupby(['Wrestler', 'Year'], as_index=False).agg({
    'Wins': 'sum',
    'Losses': 'sum',
    'Draws': 'sum'
})

# Pivot df_union_grouped to have columns for each year and metric
df_union_pivot = df_union_grouped.pivot(index='Wrestler', columns='Year', values=['Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws'])

# Flatten MultiIndex columns
df_union_pivot.columns = [f"{year} {metric}" for metric, year in df_union_pivot.columns]
df_union_pivot = df_union_pivot.reset_index()

# Now aggregate df_joined by Wrestler summing the columns (in case of duplicates)
df_joined_agg = df_joined.groupby('Wrestler', as_index=False).agg({
    'Wins_2013': 'sum',
    'Losses_2013': 'sum',
    'Draws_2013': 'sum',
    'Wins_2014': 'sum',
    'Losses_2014': 'sum',
    'Draws_2014': 'sum'
})

# Merge df_joined_agg and df_union_pivot on Wrestler
df_final = pd.merge(df_joined_agg, df_union_pivot, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
df_final = df_final.rename(columns={
    'Wins_2013': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses_2013': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws_2013': '2013 Draws',
    'Wins_2014': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses_2014': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws_2014': '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins': '2015 Wins',
    '2015 Losses': '2015 Losses',
    '2015 Draws': '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins': '2016 Wins',
    '2016 Losses': '2016 Losses',
    '2016 Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Fill NaN with 0 for numeric columns (in case some Wrestlers appear only in some years)
numeric_cols = ['2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']
df_final[numeric_cols] = df_final[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

# Save the final dataframe to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_2013 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df_2014 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df_2015 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df_2016 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns to match target schema for each year
df_2013 = df_2013.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

df_2014 = df_2014.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

df_2015 = df_2015.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

df_2016 = df_2016.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all four dataframes on 'Wrestler' using inner join to keep only wrestlers present in all years
df_joined = df_2013.merge(df_2014, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                   .merge(df_2015, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                   .merge(df_2016, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns (in case of duplicates)
# This also ensures uniqueness of Wrestler in final output
agg_columns = [
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_joined.groupby('Wrestler', as_index=False)[agg_columns].sum()

# Write to target CSV with exact column order as target schema
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_68/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
